_doc: Registry of the cloud-me-___ top hub (the cloud-me project: the owner's configs across the cloud). A SUBSET of _git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json listing only the two sub-hubs cloud-me-pub-___ and cloud-me-pvt-___; their members are listed in their own hubs, so no private repository name appears here. Identical name/url/private/doc fields to that superset; the two must not disagree. This repo is an INDEX, not a container - see clone.sh for the clone/link model.
base_dir_doc: Clones live outside this index, as siblings in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/git). This repo holds only committed symlinks pointing at them.
_visibility_doc: private:true repos require SSH access configured for this GitHub account to clone.

repos.name: cloud-me-pub-___
repos.doc: Hub of the public cloud-me family (Cloud-Me-Pub): the cloud-me-pub-profiles hub and cloud-me-pub-shared (the pub data repo is archived). Its own repos.json subset plus committed symlinks; lists no private repo. Created 2026-10-28.

repos.name: cloud-me-pvt-___
repos.doc: Hub of the private cloud-me family (Cloud-Me-Pvt): its own repos.json subset plus committed symlinks to the private cloud-me repos. Private repo. Created 2026-10-28.

_root_doc: No entries carry a group field - both sub-hubs link at the root of this index.
